IIT Kanpur Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on either an online or offline interview of the shortlisted candidates. The Selection Committee reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for shortlisting of eligible candidates, as well as increase or decrease the number of vacancies and duration of appointment for eligible candidates who satisfy qualification and experience criteria. Applicants who do not meet the minimum qualification and experience criteria will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email about the date, time, mode (online/offline) and venue/link of the interview. In case of an offline/in-person interview, no TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Kanpur Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) recruitment is 14 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) post is 8th Class along with 2 years of relevant experience in the field.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the Google form provided by IIT Kanpur. Hard copy or email applications will not be accepted. Ensure all required documents are uploaded correctly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) position is in the range of ₹ 10000 to ₹ 28000, with a potential increment of ₹ 500.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can proceed with their application without worrying about any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online or offline interview for shortlisted candidates. The selection committee may set specific criteria for shortlisting and may adjust the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to upload while applying online?
faq.answer: You need to upload a cover letter, a signed biodata, self-attested certificates of qualifications and past experience, and letters of reference from any referees.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract job at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur. The duration of the appointment will be as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply through email or by submitting a hard copy?
faq.answer: No, applications made via email or physical or hard-copy applications will not be accepted. Only online applications submitted through the Google form will be considered valid.
